raw_text: PLA Western Theater Command reinforcements moving toward Aksai Chin forward positions. Convoy of approximately 30 military vehicles spotted on G219 highway near Rutog County on June 9. Includes logistics trucks, engineering vehicles, and what appears to be mobile communications equipment. Deployment pattern suggests seasonal rotation plus additional units.
